claims.text: Machine-learning-based phase prediction can improve determination of the transition temperature of multicomponent high-entropy materials.
Machine-learning-based phase prediction can improve determination of fusion enthalpy.
Machine-learning-based phase prediction can improve determination of fusion entropy.
Machine-learning-based phase prediction can improve determination of the volume change at the transition.
Machine-learning-based phase prediction can improve determination of dense-fluid heat capacity.
The proposed improvements are relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
Phase stability is the structural mediator connecting machine-learning phase prediction to the proposed thermodynamic improvements.
Relevant materials-science factors governing phase stability in multicomponent high-entropy alloys can be identified.
Machine-learning-based phase prediction can identify the factors most relevant to phase stability.
Machine-learning-based phase prediction can identify the factors most relevant to the solid-to-fluid transition temperature.
The proposed method is applicable to multicomponent high-entropy materials at high temperatures.
The performance of the proposed machine-learning method is limited by the quality and quantity of its training data.
